title: An everywhere defined right derived Hom is an exact functor of triangulated categories
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-existence-of-derived at source lines 5436-5447: if the right derived functor of Hom(K, -) from the homotopy category to derived abelian groups is everywhere defined on the derived category, then there is a canonical exact functor of triangulated categories from the derived category to the derived category of dg E-modules, reducing to the usual one on the level of complexes of abelian groups. The proof at source lines 5449-5475 has to do two separate things. It first takes the associated functor on complexes supplied by the author's construction and proves it is exact by identifying the Hom complex out of K into the cone of a map f with the cone of the induced map of Hom complexes, which is a genuine computation and is what makes the functor compatible with distinguished triangles. It then has to pass to the derived category: using that the derived functor is everywhere defined, it argues that the quasi-isomorphism-indexed family defining it is essentially constant in derived abelian groups, and transfers that constancy to the derived category of dg E-modules using that the forgetful functor is compatible with taking cohomology. The statement records only the conclusion. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
